comments.author: Alessio71
comments.snippet:
I can confirm the issue, very few settings get saved, I managed to set most of them editing manually the mRemoteNG.settings (when mRemote NG is closed).
Not all settings are simple to find in the mRemoteNG.settings anyway.
I haven't found a way to save "always show notification area icon" or disable "Keep tabs open after disconnecting", for example.
If you make a mistake the whole mRemoteNG.settings get rewritten with default and incomplete settings.
Thanks,
Alex

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Thanks for confirming the issue @judaspriest and @bruste77!

**Root cause:** The portable settings provider (`PortableSettingsProvider`) was instantiated **17 separate times** — one per settings class (App, AppUI, OptionsAdvancedPage, etc.). Each instance had its own cached XML document but all wrote to the same `mRemoteNG.settings` file. When saving:

1. Instance 1 (App settings) saves its changes to disk ✓
